question: what holds back the AI's balancing of divisions between theatres

addresses.name: CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres
addresses.comment: Read whole on the listing, 0x48E490 to the bare `ret` at 0x48F2AD. ProcessAI at hour id%24 for an AI-run country once unit_pass_done is set. (1) For every unit agent (+0x40) with a unit (slot 74) whose root theatre resolves: CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower - the daily refresh of divisions_needed (+0x354), divisions_counted (+0x358) and the powers - then CEU3AI_InsertAgentByShortage (0x49C140) into a local list sorted by key = need - count, less 1000 unless frontier_at_war (+0x364): descending, ties in agent order. (2) For each taker A from the head: skipped when need < count and frontier_war_candidate (+0x365) is clear. The donors are the other listed agents, walked from the tail; a donor whose theatre is connected to A's (CTheatre_IsConnectedTo, 0xB0710) goes to the front of A's donor list and the rest to the back. For each donor B: skipped when A.+0x365 is clear, B.+0x364 is set and B's plan stance (CUnit +0x208) <= 2; skipped when 3*needA - countA < 1; skipped when A.+0x365 is clear, B.+0x364 is set and countA >= 2*|A ops area (+0x90)|/3. (3) Whole-unit grab: when connected, A.+0x365 set, B.+0x365 clear and needA > needB, every division of B holding a motorized, mechanized, armor, light_armor or heavy_armor brigade (CAIUnit_CollectMobileDivisions, 0x4BF660, rolled up to whole commands) is detached and attached under A's unit. (4) General: ratioA = countA/needA, ratioB = countB/needB (1.0 where the need is 0); thresholds (t1, t2) = (0.4, 0.15), or (0.3, 0.1) with A.+0x365, or (0.35, 0.125) with both +0x365. If ratioB - t1 > ratioA, n counts up while n < needA - countA and (countA+n)/needA < (countB-n)/needB - t2. minGive = countB - needB when A.+0x365 and connected and B.+0x365 clear (and then only units of max_speed >= 2000 qualify), (countB - needB)/2 when both are +0x365, connected and countB > 2*needB, else 0; n = min(max(n, minGive), 3*needA - countA); nothing below 1. The need scale f = 1 - min(n/(countB - n - minGive), 1) where that divisor is positive, else 1. CAIUnit_PickDivisionsToGive (0x4BF8E0)(B, n, n, fastOnly, A's theatre, f) chooses the units. (5) Each chosen unit: GetPower moved from B's +0x35C to A's, CDetachUnitCommand then CAttachUnitCommand(unit, A's unit) posted - no march; A's +0x358 up and B's down by the divisions moved (1 for a division, CUnit::CountDivisions over a command's children). The counts are re-read for each donor. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section F. **Three things checked on the listing, 2026-11-09 (FINDINGS-balancing.md).** The `free(list); return` the decompiler prints at the end of each taker's donor list and of the function is the node-freeing loop (0x88F243-0x88F253, then `jne 0x88e5a0` to the next taker): nothing stops a pass after one taker or one transfer. n is the first count at which the test fails or the taker's shortage is reached (0x88ED90-0x88EDF7). The constants are the floats 0.4, 0.15, 0.3, 0.1, 0.35 and 0.125 at VA 0x170AC10, 0x160A894, 0x15C05EC, 0x15C05F8, 0x160AA1C and 0x160AA18.
addresses.evidence: Listing read 0x88E86C-0x88EE83 and 0x88F1D0-0x88F2AD; the six floats read out of the image. Shown wrong by a branch out of the taker loop other than the one at 0x88F276, or a float differing from those printed. Against the saves the arithmetic alone gives USA East to West 6, Poland 20 and Manchukuo 3 exactly, with the division needs of a model.
addresses.revises: adds to the comment what the listing settled about the pass ending, n and the constants; nothing that was recorded changes

addresses.name: CAIUnit_PickDivisionsToGive
addresses.signature: CList* __stdcall CAIUnit_PickDivisionsToGive(CAIUnit* agent, CList* out, int maxCount, int quota, bool fastOnly, CTheatre* toTheatre, float needScale)
addresses.comment: The donor's choice of up to maxCount divisions for another theatre. Per owner area of the donor's theatre (+0x84): keep = round-half-even(EstimateAreaNeed(agent, area, relaxed) x needScale), at least 1 where the need is above 0; have = CAIUnit::CountDivisionsInArea. Candidates, in +0x11C order: divisions (level 4, a brigade) other than the agent's unit; not army_role 8; army_role 5 only off a province of more than 9 victory points or its own supply depot; CAIUnit_UnitMayLeave(agent, unit, candidates, false, true); not bound (CUnit_GetPendingDestinationProvince) for an enemy-controlled province; with fastOnly, definition max_speed >= 2000; not standing on the agent's target-area provinces (+0x1CC); and not in an area whose have <= keep with keep > 0. maxD = the largest DistanceToTheatreFronts(province, toTheatre) over them (0.1 when 0). Then repeatedly, while fewer than maxCount are picked: over the unpicked candidates with k = CAIUnit_CountIdleDivisionsBesideWarCandidate >= 1 (with quota < 1 instead k - enemies >= 1; quota counts down from maxCount, so never here): skipped when the agent is +0x365, fastOnly is clear and the division holds a motorized, mechanized, armor, light_armor or heavy_armor brigade; score = (1 - distance/maxD) x (15 if its parent is a parent already picked from, else 10), x 0.25 unless its area is one of toTheatre's areas or touches one (COwnerArea +0x34), / 3 when it holds a bergsjaeger brigade, stands idle on a mountain province of the agent's ops area (+0x90, terrain is_mountain), x min(k/100, 1); the strictly highest above 0 is picked, the first of equals, and its parent (not the agent's unit) is listed. Nothing left: stop. Finally CAIUnit_RollUpWholeCommands. `ret 0x1C`. One caller. The name is ours. **Checked on the listing, 2026-11-09 (FINDINGS-balancing.md).** keep is the map at [ebp-0x98] and have the map at [ebp-0xC4]; have takes CountDivisionsInArea's return, the power it fills being overwritten at 0x8BFA83; the test at 0x8BFBFE-0x8BFC0F is have <= keep and keep > 0. **Both maps are made once**, before any pick, so what has been picked does not lower have. **The candidate at the greatest distance scores nought and is never picked**: a donor with one candidate, or with all its candidates at one distance, gives nothing, and one with m gives at most m - 1.
addresses.evidence: Listing read 0x8BF9A0-0x8BFCA8; the score (1 - d / maxD) with maxD the greatest d over the candidates and the strict test against the best so far, from 0, at 0x8BFFA5-0x8BFFA9 (`comisd`, `jbe`). Shown wrong by a write to either map after 0x8BFC11, or by a pick with score 0.
addresses.revises: adds to the comment which map is which, that neither is updated during the picking, and that the farthest candidate cannot be picked; nothing that was recorded changes
